item.tib: 'jig byed gshin rje gshed dmar gyi rgyud las ma mo sbod stong srid pa spyi 'dul dbal mo las kyi thig le'i mde'u thung mi mthun bar chad bzlog pa'i 'khor lo brgya dmod gcig zlog
item.coloph: ces 'jig byed gshin rje gshed dmar gyi rgyud las ma mo sbod stong las kyi thig le'i mde'u thung bzlog pa'i 'khor lo brgya dmod gcig zlog 'di ni/ drin can gsang sngags grags pa bstan sbyin nor bu mched gnyis sogs slob ma 'ga' yi (yis) bskul ba'i ngor/ klad med kun grol grags pa bdag gis shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams/ lhun 'grub dpag bsam ljon pa gling du me 'brug hor zla bzhi pa'i dmar phyogs su brtsams pa gshen bstan gsal ba'i sgron me ru gyur cig sarba mang+ga lam//
